statements.t: We intend to continue to weigh state-level priorities much more heavily in the development of future products as well.

While we maintain a library of the evidence we have accumulated about the outcomes one can expect when using our products, and while this library of evidence has helped us win larger orders, we believe that expanding this library and upgrading the tiers of evidence we have will produce meaningful benefits for future sales.
We are early in this process, but we intend to substantially build out our library of evidence of our products’ effectiveness.
The nature of our target market produces considerable seasonality for the Company’s revenue.

We believe that we can resume the success we experienced in soliciting larger customers, but we can offer no assurances that success will be certain; nor can we offer any numerical framework in describing the success that may occur.
While we do not expect to pay federal income taxes for fiscal year 2027, the deferred tax asset will be adjusted on a quarterly basis to reflect the amount of taxes it is offsetting for the quarter.

risks.t: competitive pressures from other companies within the Educational Industries
economic conditions in the Company’s primary markets
weather conditions and other uncertainties, including those detailed in our SEC filings
